Teva Phrm Ind LTD Adr (TEVA) Holder Kempner Capital Management Cut Its Holding; Royal Bank Of Canada (RY) Shareholder Payden & Rygel Increased Its Stake by $1.39 Million as Valuation Declined
May 15, 2018 - By Dolores Ford
Payden & Rygel increased its stake in Royal Bank Of Canada (RY) by 11.65% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Payden & Rygel bought 17,100 shares as the company’s stock declined 4.81% with the market. The institutional investor held 163,900 shares of the commercial banks company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $13.38 million, up from 146,800 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Payden & Rygel who had been investing in Royal Bank Of Canada for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $112.82 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.32% or $0.25 during the last trading session, reaching $78.58. About 500,711 shares traded. Royal Bank of Canada (NYSE:RY) has risen 5.90% since May 15, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 5.65% the S&P500.
Kempner Capital Management Inc decreased its stake in Teva Phrm Ind Ltd Adr (TEVA) by 63.06% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Kempner Capital Management Inc sold 131,773 shares as the company’s stock declined 11.04% with the market. The institutional investor held 77,184 shares of the major pharmaceuticals company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $1.46 million, down from 208,957 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Kempner Capital Management Inc who had been investing in Teva Phrm Ind Ltd Adr for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $20.67B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.39% or $0.08 during the last trading session, reaching $20.3. About 8.19M shares traded. Teva Pharmaceutical Industries Limited (NYSE:TEVA) has declined 49.50% since May 15, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 61.05% the S&P500.
Among 35 analysts covering Teva Pharma ( NYSE:TEVA ), 9 have Buy rating, 8 Sell and 18 Hold. Therefore 26% are positive. Teva Pharma had 153 analyst reports since July 21, 2015 according to SRatingsIntel. JP Morgan reinitiated it with “Overweight” rating and $82.0 target in Monday, August 3 report. The stock has “Buy” rating by Goldman Sachs on Monday, August 10. Mizuho maintained the shares of TEVA in report on Friday, April 20 with “Buy” rating. The company was maintained on Monday, February 13 by Maxim Group. The firm has “Neutral” rating by Bank of America given on Monday, November 7. The stock has “Hold” rating by Mizuho on Thursday, October 26. The rating was upgraded by Credit Suisse on Monday, October 31 to “Outperform”. The rating was maintained by Maxim Group with “Buy” on Wednesday, November 16. The stock has “Underweight” rating by JP Morgan on Monday, November 13. RBC Capital Markets maintained it with “Sell” rating and $15.0 target in Thursday, October 19 report.
Kempner Capital Management Inc, which manages about $421.42M and $160.10M US Long portfolio, upped its stake in Cardinal Health Inc (NYSE:CAH) by 49,937 shares to 69,392 shares, valued at $4.25M in 2017Q4, according to the filing.

Analysts await Teva Pharmaceutical Industries Limited (NYSE:TEVA) to report earnings on August, 2. They expect $0.59 EPS, down 40.40% or $0.40 from last year’s $0.99 per share. TEVA’s profit will be $600.75M for 8.60 P/E if the $0.59 EPS becomes a reality. After $0.91 actual EPS reported by Teva Pharmaceutical Industries Limited for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts -35.16% negative EPS growth.
Payden & Rygel, which manages about $82.81 billion and $1.15 billion US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Chevron (NYSE:CVX) by 182,500 shares to 38,550 shares, valued at $4.83M in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Williams Partners (ACMP) by 348,400 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 12,300 shares, and cut its stake in Costco Wholesale (NASDAQ:COST).
